articles.title: U.S. SEC begins prepping for around-the-clock trading that crypto treats as the norm
articles.snippet: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission dug into plans for around-the-clock trading in an event on the same morning it approved tokenized securities.

articles.title: Clarity Act failure may hamper U.S. crypto as industry seeks legal clarity elsewhere
articles.snippet: The U.S. is likely to lose out to foreign markets in the short term, but SEC and CFTC rules will help underpin the industry.

articles.title: Zcash jumps 23% as bitcoin and major tokens rise despite Fed’s first hike since 2023
articles.snippet: Bitcoin traded above $76,000 as the Fed projected limited further tightening, while Paradigm’s Matt Huang discussed Zcash’s role as a privacy complement to bitcoin.

articles.title: Goldman pivots, now forecasts Fed rate hike in October
articles.snippet: The Fed is likely to raise rates by 25 basis points in October, Goldman said, drawing attention to Fed's own hawkish near term rate projections.

articles.title: WisdomTree, MoonPay team up to expand US access to tokenized money market fund
articles.snippet: MoonPay plans to use WisdomTree’s $1.2 billion WTGXX tokenized fund as part of its stablecoin reserves while helping expand access to US investors.
